oneSentence: A proposed, unvalidated research framework (QIF, TARA, NISS) for threat modeling, severity scoring and impact assessment of neural devices.
summary: QIF, TARA and NISS help builders and defenders start a neural-device threat model, rank which protections to build first, and describe potential impact in shared terms. Status: a proposed research framework; unvalidated, not a standard, not clinical guidance or a compliance tool.

segments.text: A shared vocabulary for threat modeling, severity scoring and impact assessment of neural devices. TARA borrows the structure of MITRE ATT&CK, a knowledge base of adversary techniques based on real-world observations; TARA entries range from confirmed to speculative, and each carries an evidence status. NISS follows the CVSS v4.0 extension method; like CVSS Base scores, NISS scores measure severity, not risk. FDA's premarket cybersecurity guidance (Feb 2026, nonbinding) recommends that submissions include threat modeling documentation.
Proposed and unvalidated. Not adopted or endorsed by MITRE, FIRST, FDA or any standards body.

Not clinical guidance, a medical device or a compliance tool, and not a substitute for a manufacturer's own threat model. It models attacks on neural signals, devices and decoder outputs (such as attempted speech), not general access to thought. DSM-5-TR names are category references for threat modeling, not diagnostic claims.
